title: Perfect tensor direct image with proper support on algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of finite presentation between algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]; finite presentation is tested on compatible etale scheme charts. All sites are taken small relative to the universe of their module sheaves [def-weil-size-convention]. Module derived categories are the unbounded localizations of cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. On a ringed site, a perfect object means one locally isomorphic in that derived category to a bounded complex whose terms are direct summands of finite free structure modules. A quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space is as in [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], and $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$ denotes the full subcategory of objects with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves. For morphisms of algebraic spaces use the canonical ringed small etale module functors [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], their total derived functors $La^*\dashv Ra_*$, and derived tensor product of modules. Derived pullback is computed by tensor pullback of K-flat resolutions with flat terms, and derived direct image by K-injective resolutions. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ be perfect, and let $G^\bullet$ be a bounded complex of quasi-coherent finitely presented $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Finite presentation means locally admitting an exact presentation $\mathcal O^m\to\mathcal O^n\to G^i\to0$ with finite $m,n$. Assume each $G^i$ is flat over $Y$, meaning that its geometric stalk at $\bar x$ is flat over $\mathcal O_{Y,f(\bar x)}$, and that its support, with the closed subspace structure cut out by its annihilator, is proper over $Y$. Proper means separated, of finite type and universally closed. Then $Rf_*(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}G^\bullet)$ is perfect in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and has quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves.

proof.text: First, every perfect object $P$ on any algebraic space has quasi-coherent cohomology. Indeed, on its etale strict-perfect charts each term is a direct summand of $\mathcal O^n$, hence is $\ker(1-e)$ for an idempotent $e$ on $\mathcal O^n$. The structure module is quasi-coherent by its identity presentation. Kernels, images and cokernels of quasi-coherent modules are quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-kernels-colimits], so the cohomology of the strict-perfect model is quasi-coherent. Restriction is exact by [lem-sfb-ringed-site-restriction-kflat], and quasi-coherence is local by [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Thus $P$ has quasi-coherent cohomology; in particular $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$.

Apply [lem-sfb-space-perfect-flat-proper-model] to obtain the etale affine cover $U_a\to Y$, the Noetherian models $(f_{a,0},E_{a,0},G_{a,0}^\bullet)$, and the displayed derived and ordinary coefficient identifications. This descends data, not a direct image. Each $f_{a,0}$ is finitely presented, hence locally of finite type and quasi-separated; its coefficient complex is bounded coherent, relatively flat, and termwise properly supported. Therefore [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-tensor-perfect] gives a perfect object $K_{a,0}=Rf_{a,0,*}(E_{a,0}\otimes^{\mathbf L}G_{a,0}^\bullet)$.

source.place: Tag 0A1P, proof: descent of X, G and E, then Tag 0DKJ

proof.text: Put $K=Rf_*(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}G^\bullet)$. Both $f$ and $f_{a,0}$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Step 1 applies to $E_{a,0}$ as well. Apply [lem-sfb-space-flat-complex-base-change] first to $U_a\to Y$ and then to $g_a:U_a\to U_{a,0}$. The model identifications give isomorphisms $Lu_a^*K\simeq Rf_{a,*}(Lv_a^*E\otimes^{\mathbf L}v_a^*G^\bullet)\simeq Lg_a^*K_{a,0}$. In both applications the coefficient pullback is ordinary termwise pullback, exactly as the model provides.

Derived pullback of a perfect object is perfect: choose its local bounded strict-perfect models. [lem-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-ringed-pullback-model] computes their derived pullbacks by bounded termwise pullback with the same finite-free splittings. These give strict-perfect models locally on the inverse-image covering, so $Lg_a^*K_{a,0}$ is perfect. Hence $Lu_a^*K$ is perfect for every $a$. Etale pullback is restriction by [def-trf-algebraic-space], so these local models, composed with the jointly surjective etale cover $\{U_a\to Y\}$, are local strict-perfect models for $K$. This is precisely perfectness on $Y$. Step 1 applied to $K$ gives its quasi-coherent cohomology.
